title: transit/admin.rs module doc claims /reload returns {reloaded:true}
description: crates/transit/src/admin.rs line 17 says: 'POST /reload — signal daemon to reload config (stub, returns {"reloaded":true})'. The actual implementation (line 388) returns HTTP 501 with {"reloaded":false,"error":"..."}. An operator reading the module doc to understand the endpoint will get the wrong expectation — they'll think their config was applied when it wasn't. Same comment exists in reader/src/admin.rs and was also updated for reader but not transit. Fix: update transit module comment to match actual 501 behaviour.
